.mcp.json.purpose: Project MCP servers for Claude Code: graphify (code graph from graphify-out/graph.json).

README.md.purpose: What the site shows, how it is engineered (no build step, MVVM, pearl, sound) and how to run it.

css/components.css.purpose: Reusable components: navigation, buttons, links, chips, swatches, toast, lightbox.

css/fonts.css.purpose: Self-hosted brand faces (SIL Open Font License).

index.html.purpose: The single-page site: all sections in page order.

js/app.js.purpose: Composition root: builds the view models and binds them to their views.

js/audio/calm-ocean-engine.js.purpose: Plays "Calm Ocean" from Aethéa: the generators run in an AudioWorklet, and this file builds the rest of the app's graph (Audio/SoundscapeEng

js/audio/calm-ocean-processor.js.purpose: "Calm Ocean" from Aethéa, ported line for line from the app's Swift generators.

js/core/storage.js.purpose: Best-effort preference storage: private windows and blocked site data must not break the page.

js/core/subject.js.purpose: A minimal value publisher, in the spirit of Combine's CurrentValueSubject.

js/core/tabs.js.purpose: ARIA tabs bound to a SelectionViewModel: click or arrow keys select, Home and End jump.

js/model/content.js.purpose: Content model: the data behind the interactive parts of the page.

js/render/pearl.js.purpose: The Synthetic Pearl, rendered with Canvas 2D.

js/viewmodels/ambience-view-model.js.purpose: The site's ambient sound: "Calm Ocean" from Aethéa.

js/viewmodels/appearance-view-model.js.purpose: Resolves the appearance from an explicit choice, else the device setting, and publishes it.

js/viewmodels/selection-view-model.js.purpose: Holds which item of a list is selected, wrapping at both ends.

js/views/ambience-toggle-view.js.purpose: The header sound switch: plays or pauses "Calm Ocean".

js/views/contact-view.js.purpose: Turns the main call to action into an email link once an address is configured.

js/views/evolution-view.js.purpose: Version timeline as an accessible tab list: arrow keys move between versions, Home and End jump.

js/views/gallery-view.js.purpose: Opens gallery images in a native <dialog>; Escape and the close button dismiss it.

js/views/hero-view.js.purpose: The live hero pearl: static layers cached, only the signal moves; pauses off-screen.

js/views/palette-view.js.purpose: Colour swatches; selecting one copies its hex value.

js/views/pronounce-view.js.purpose: "Hear it": reads the name aloud with the device's speech engine, when there is one.

js/views/toast-view.js.purpose: Shows the toast view model's message, hidden when empty.

native/Synthea/Rendering/GraphicsContext.purpose: GraphicsContext drawing of the pearl (body, sheen, rim, signal) for PearlView.

native/Synthea/Views/PearlView.swift.purpose: The live Synthetic Pearl: drawn every frame while visible, still for Reduce Motion.

sw.js.purpose: Offline support: the page shell is cached on install; images and fonts are cached as they are used.

tools/codemap.py.purpose: Keeps .claude/codemap/index.json in step with the repo's files.

tools/highlight-swift.py.purpose: Refreshes the Swift shown on the page from native/.
